shorts.title: What you will learn: else if ladders
shorts.hook: The order of your tests changes the answer.
shorts.script: The order of your tests changes the answer. Today we handle more than two cases. We build a grade calculator with an else if ladder. An else if ladder checks tests from the top down. The first true test runs, and the rest are skipped. A final else catches all other cases. The order matters. Put the strictest test first. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Tests in the wrong order
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. A student has eighty-two marks. The program prints Pass, not Distinction. The loose test is first, and eighty-two passes it. The ladder stops there. Always put the strictest test first. Then the ladder works from the top down. Eighty-two passes the first test, so the ladder stops. The strict test below never gets a turn. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
